The scene matches the requested neutral seedling/agronomy drip-tape context, and the carton is not being used as operating plumbing hardware. Core evidence defect: the installed in-row irrigation lines are rendered as straight rigid metallic-looking rods/straps rather than thin flattened PE drip-tape laterals, and the localized wetting is a visible puddle/standing water pool rather than root-zone drip wetting. This contradicts the requested technical evidence and makes the irrigation geometry implausible as drip tape. Additional advisory/minor issues: the white uninstalled tape strip appears to start from the middle of the roll rather than the roll core/leading edge, and the small secondary print under 'AFP' is garbled/blurry, though the main logo is still readable.
